```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r Heatmap, fig.path = '../docs/figure/'}
# Tested on R Version 4.4.2 
# ggplot2 Version 3.5.2
# WDI Version 2.7.9
# dplyr Version 1.1.4
# viridis Version 0.6.5
# forcats Version 1.0.0 
# tidyr Version 1.3.1

# Install and load packages ---------------
packages <- c("WDI", 
              "dplyr", 
              "ggplot2", 
              "viridis",
              "tidyr",
              "forcats")

# Change to install = TRUE to install the required packages
pacman::p_load(packages, character.only = TRUE, install = FALSE)

# Load an example dataset // Query from the World Bank API ---------
# https://databank.worldbank.org/source/world-development-indicators

indicators <- c(
  rural = "EG.ELC.ACCS.RU.ZS", # Access to electricity (% of rural population) 
  urban = "EG.ELC.ACCS.UR.ZS" # Access to electricity (% of urban population)
)

elec_data <- WDI(
  country = "all",    # or e.g., c("US", "IN", "CN")
  indicator = indicators,   
  start = 2000,
  end = 2023,
  extra = TRUE        # adds region, income level, etc.      
)

# Clean -------------------------
elec_clean <- elec_data %>%
  filter(region != "Aggregates") %>%
  select(income, year, rural, urban) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rural), !is.na(urban))

elec_grouped <- elec_clean %>%
  group_by(income, year) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rural = mean(rural, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_urban = mean(urban, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

elec_long <- elec_grouped %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("avg"), names_to = "area", values_to = "access") %>%
  mutate(area = recode(area, avg_rural = "Rural", avg_urban = "Urban"))

# Plot ------------------------------
ggplot(elec_long %>% filter(income != "Not classified"), aes(x = year, y = fct_rev(income), fill = access)) +
 geom_tile(color = "white") +
 facet_wrap(~area) +
 scale_fill_gradient2(low = "white", mid = "darkorange", high = "darkred", 
                      midpoint = 35, name = "% Access", limits = c(0, 100), na.value = "grey90") +
 labs(
   title = "Access to Electricity by Income Group (World Bank)",
   subtitle = "Average % access to electricity in rural and urban areas, 2000–2023",
   x = "Year", y = "Income Group"
 ) +
 theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

## Annex

# For more use cases, authors can swap `EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS` with any other WDI indicator for new visualizations
# Authors can also adapt the `select` logic for **low-access**, **specific regions**, or **bottom 10 / top 10** as needed 
# Example: choose bottom 10 countries by recent electricity access 
# But note that using too many variables creates an incomprehensible heatmap

  # scale_fill_gradient2(low = "white", mid = "orange", high = "darkred", 
  #                      midpoint = 50, name = "% Access", limits = c(0, 100), na.value = "grey90")

  #                      limits = c(0, 100), na.value = "grey90")
```
